meta.source: tackle.xlsx, sheets Lines and Leaders (fish habit editor config tables)
meta.source_ids: Rows are copied by id only; no private paths or internal addresses are stored.
meta.status: Test data for an experiment. Not production data, not a Contract.
meta.additions: clarity is an added test parameter (0 = fully visible material, 1 = fully clear). The current config has opacity and color, but no material-clarity field. Values are declared assumptions, not extracted facts.
meta.units: diameter is used in the workbook's own units. Line and leader diameters are normalized within their own class; cross-class unit comparison is not assumed.
meta.exposure_note: Rig visibility is multiplied by 0.5 to produce a SuspicionLoad in the Working 0..1 range; this is an assumption, not a contract value.
